material_findings.title: Three.js tiled shadows merged into dev
material_findings.source_quality: A: merged upstream PR and code
material_findings.evidence: For a 3840x2160 PCF fullscreen receiver on M1 with shadow maps pre-rendered, maintainer reports 2x2: 8.71 to 7.06 ms; 4x4: 16.02 to 7.06 ms; 8x8: 169.68 to 7.11 ms. Merged October 7. Separate WebGPU depth-view bug fix merged first.
material_findings.contradiction: Review established old path already performed one PCF filter per fragment; gains are from eliminating redundant tile transforms/tests, not avoiding 16 filter passes. Numbers are a single-device GPU microbenchmark, not our mobile or end-to-end workloads.
material_findings.implication: Amend EXP-THREE-R187-001: compare pinned released vs dev, ordinary shadows vs 2x2/4x4/8x8 tiled shadows; isolate shader sampling from shadow rendering costs.

material_findings.title: Instanced WebGPU node-build optimization split after correctness review
material_findings.evidence: Original PR #34776 is closed without merge, following review of incorrect morph target, RangeNode and velocity/TAA behavior. Replacement #34819 and dependent velocity follow-up #34820 remain open October 8.
material_findings.contradiction: Earlier 1,316 to 142 shader-build and ~30s to ~5s compilation figures are upstream author's benchmark estimates, not production validation. Tests must not treat the original PR as a shipped implementation.
material_findings.implication: Separate dev baseline, candidate #34819, and velocity-enabled #34820 for EXP-THREE-R187-001. Cover differing instance counts, RangeNode, morph targets, TAA velocity, instance colors, and screenshot correctness.

no_other_material_promotions: Targeted check covered Catalan/Spanish Gaudi scholarship, computational form-finding, Blender, Khronos glTF and KTX, meshoptimizer, product visualization, capture/splats, sports physics, perceptual LOD, and AI 3D. No additional material change was substantiated.
action_status: Research evidence only; no experiments run, no production touched.
